name: Emma Kenny
text: Sof has been amazingly helpful with plant care - she has personally saved many of my house plants from the brink of death, and has been a godsend for re-potting plants and cuttings. Most notably she helped me split up and re-pot 3 huge bird of paradise plants so they could really thrive!

name: Jeanette
text: Anyone looking for a superb cleaner, organizer and/or someone to help declutter your home needs to reach out to Sofia. She has been cleaning for me since February and has made my living space feel so much like home.

name: Helen
text: I have used the cleaning and plant care services from Port Credit Cleaning and was very happy with the outcome. Sof's attention to my requests was thorough and careful. My needs were met and innovative suggestions were offered! I will be definitely setting up the on-going periodic services with this team.
